snippet.title: Ariokan - Closed Beta game trailer
snippet.description:
Ariokan is the online card game where you can create your own balanced cards at any time to invent new strategies and break the Meta.

Learn more on: https://www.playariokan.com
Wishlist on Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/ariokan-536e54

✔️ 27+ Billion combinations: everybody can invent a competitive, auto-balanced deck. 
✔️ New content, every day: as players create new cards constantly, you'll never see the same deck twice.
✔️ Play to unlock everything: no pay to win.
✔️ No floodgates, no 10-minutes turns: play and have fun.
✔️ Invent new strategies that define the Meta, and find countermoves to break it in an endless cycle of creativity.

Explore a vast and ever-expanding universe, craft innovative new gameplay mechanics mixing Gods, Legends, and Factions, and battle against other players in thrilling matches.

-----------------

On this channel, you'll find tutorials on how to design your own Ariokan cards, deck-building strategies, gameplay highlights, and updates on the latest game features and events.
Whether you're a seasoned card game veteran or a newcomer to the genre, there's a place for you in Ariokan.

Join us as we push the boundaries of what a collectible card game can be. Subscribe now to stay up to date on all the latest Ariokan content!

Join our Reddit's subreddit here: https://www.reddit.com/r/ariokan/

#Ariokan #collectiblecardgame #gametrailer
